new_setup.title: Automated Garden Watering — global settings
new_setup.description: Set up your pump, backwash valve, and timing defaults. Both switches are optional — leave empty if you don't have that hardware.

data.backwash_interval: Automatic backwash interval — seconds of cumulative watering between automatic backwashes (0 = off)
data.backwash_threshold: End-of-queue backwash threshold — minimum seconds of total watering before an end-of-queue backwash runs

data_description.pump_switch: The Home Assistant switch entity that controls your well pump. Will be turned on before any valve opens.
data_description.backwash_switch: The Home Assistant switch entity for the backwash valve. If empty, all backwash behavior is disabled.
data_description.pump_pressure_delay: Time to wait after turning on the pump and before opening a valve. Runs once at the start of a queue.
data_description.backwash_pressure_delay: Time to build up pressure (pump on, valves closed) before the backwash starts.
data_description.backwash_runtime: Reverse-flow phase: the pump is turned OFF and the backwash valve opened, so water flows backwards through the filter and dislodges the dirt.
data_description.backwash_flush_runtime: Flush phase: the pump is turned back ON (backwash valve still open) to flush the dislodged dirt out.
data_description.backwash_interval: After this many seconds of cumulative watering, the controller pauses watering and runs a backwash, then resumes.
data_description.backwash_threshold: When a queue finishes, run a final backwash if at least this much watering happened (or if the queue was started by the timer).

data_description.pump_switch: Switch turned on before any valve opens.
data_description.backwash_switch: Backwash valve switch. Leave empty to disable backwash.
data_description.pump_pressure_delay: Wait this long after the pump comes on before opening a valve.
data_description.backwash_pressure_delay: Build up pressure (pump on, valves closed) for this long before the backwash starts.
data_description.backwash_runtime: Reverse-flow phase: pump OFF, backwash valve open — water flows backwards and dislodges the dirt.
data_description.backwash_flush_runtime: Flush phase: pump back ON, backwash valve still open — flushes the dislodged dirt out.
data_description.backwash_interval: Run a backwash automatically after this much cumulative watering. 0 disables it.
data_description.backwash_threshold: Final backwash runs only if at least this much watering happened (or if the queue was timer-started).
